model_or_product: Hawk I Linear Pre-Amp / Fuzz; Hawk II Tonal Expander
evidence_summary: Effects Database documents S. Hawk Limited and designer Harry Kolbe, with Hawk I debuting in 1973 as a switchable overdrive, distortion and fuzz device. Independent historical discussion documents the Hawk II Tonal Expander and connects the product lineage to Kolbe/Soundsmith. Preserve S. Hawk as the builder identity and Harry Kolbe as designer/lineage metadata.
